title: Topological Detection of Hopf Bifurcations via Persistent Homology: A Functional Criterion from Time Series
abstract: arXiv:2603.27395v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We propose a topological framework for detecting Hopf-type dynamical transitions directly from scalar time series. The method combines delay-coordinate reconstruction with persistent homology and uses the maximum persistence of one-dimensional homology classes as a scalar descriptor of cyclic structure. For the supercritical Hopf setting, we derive finite-resolution persistence bounds that relate detectability of the reconstructed periodic orbit to its geometry, sampling quality, and finite-data perturbations. A derivative-based estimator is then introduced to localize the critical parameter from the sampled topological functional. The approach is evaluated on the Hopf normal form, the Lorenz system, and a reduced Belousov--Zhabotinsky model. translated_title: 基于持续同调检测Hopf分岔的拓扑方法：来自时间序列的函数准则
translated_abstract: 摘要：我们提出了一种直接从标量时间序列检测Hopf型动力学转变的拓扑框架。该方法将延迟坐标重构与持续同调相结合，并使用一维同调类的最大持续度作为循环结构的标量描述符。对于超临界Hopf设置，我们推导了有限分辨率持续度界限，将重构周期轨道的可检测性与其几何形状、采样质量和有限数据扰动联系起来。然后引入基于导数的估计器，从采样的拓扑函数中定位临界参数。该方法在Hopf标准型、洛伦兹系统和简化Belousov-Zhabotinsky模型上进行了评估。数值实验显示了相应转变的准确有限分辨率定位，并说明了嵌入参数、时间采样、平滑等因素的影响。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于持续同调的新拓扑框架，直接从时间序列中检测Hopf分岔，并通过导数估计器精确定位临界参数，在多个系统中验证了有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel topological framework based on persistent homology to detect Hopf bifurcations directly from time series, with a derivative-based estimator for critical parameter localization, validated across multiple systems.
